mapper.select: INSERT INTO derive_chapter_contract ( run_id, chapter_no, volume_no, required_roles, target_state_before, target_state_after, reveal_level, min_beats, max_beats, outline_contract, pack_version ) VALUES ( #{p.runId}, #{p.chapterNo}, #{p.volumeNo}, #{p.requiredRoles}::jsonb, #{p.targetStateBefore}::jsonb, #{p.targetStateAfter}::jsonb, #{p.revealLevel}, #{p.minBeats}, #{p.maxBeats}, #{p.outlineContract}, #{p.packVersion} ) ON CONFLICT (run_id, chapter_no) DO UPDATE SET volume_no = EXCLUDED.volume_no, required_roles = EXCLUDED.required_roles, target_state_before = EXCLUDED.target_state_before, target_state_after = EXCLUDED.target_state_after, reveal_level = EXCLUDED.reveal_level, min_beats = EXCLUDED.min_beats, max_beats = EXCLUDED.max_beats, outline_contract = EXCLUDED.outline_contract, pack_version = EXCLUDED.pack_version, updated_time = NOW() RETURNING id
